analyst_view.overall: Third-placed Paris FC (20 points, unbeaten at home) host Angers (16th, 8 points), who are winless in five and have not scored in their last three games. Liam Rosenior's side lean on Lassine Sinayoko, the league's top scorer; Ikoné played a friendly and is back, Sangui returns too, while Chergui and Adama Camara are doubts. Angers (Stéphane Gilli) miss the suspended Lefort (counted) and Bané Diatta, with Ousmane Camara doubtful; striker El Ouazzani is back in the squad but may start on the bench behind Peter. Angers are expected in a five-man defence away from home. Referee Aurélien Petit (2.5 cards a game in four games) is already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals and already add a little for Lefort's absence in Angers' defence. Angers have not scored in three games and will sit in a back five, but Paris FC are strong at home with Sinayoko in form and Ikoné back; the two pull in opposite directions, so I stay at 2.6.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.8 corners. Against a deep five-man defence Paris FC are likely to have long spells of pressure out wide, which tends to produce corners, so I nudge it up to about 9.1.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.2 cards and already take some off for Petit's lenient start. Nothing points to a heated game, so I stay at 3.2.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.0 shots, with Paris FC doing most of the shooting. Angers' attack has dried up, but Paris FC should get more shots against a deep block; I stay at 26.0.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.8 shots on target. Sinayoko is in form and Ikoné is back for Paris FC, while Angers have barely tested goalkeepers lately; these balance out, so I stay at 8.8.
